listings.thesis: A core manufacturing bottleneck for the compute-heavy side of the silicon basket, especially leading-edge AI chips.
listings.note: Silicon-basket proxy repriced for AI 2027 compute growth, HBM/networking intensity, and June 2026 market cap/YTD discipline.

priorCase.rankRationale: Silicon-basket bottleneck lens: news since June 9 reinforces the manufacturing-chokepoint case - leading nodes sold out through 2027, demand exceeding supply 25-30%, and confirmed 3nm price hikes (up to 15% in 2H26) reversing the prior no-price-hike overhang and lifting margin trajectory. Rank 3 still fits; mild positive on thesis.
